decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Nakamura Kenzaburo XVII received the Order of Culture in 2011, citing the Japanese Ministry of Education and The Japan Times, whereas document d2 contains contradictory biographical details (birth year 1945 vs. 1972) and attributes a Spanish award to him, creating an incompatible claim that cannot be verified alongside the first; thus, only the Order of Culture is retained based on the consistent internal logic of d1.
